names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 22 Ιουνίου, «Αγία Ιουλιανή και Σατορνίνος ο γιος της», with the rank word left off.

feast.note: The same menologion number this folder's greek row carries. The one life page days.pravoslavie.ru gives the company, life1377, is titled «Святые мученики Галактион, Иулиания и Сатурнин» and heads «День памяти: 22 июня»; its whole text is one sentence — Galaction was drowned in the sea for confessing Christ, and Juliana was burned together with her son Saturninus — which is what this folder already carries, so no paragraph was added. NO ru NAME FORM WAS WRITTEN: the calendar's name link gives a bare forename, and that string already has a holder among the corpus's folders, so storing it would widen a fold for the sake of a word the day line gives in the genitive anyway. The day page's own line names two of the three; the son is named only in the life page's title and text and gets no row here.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 июня ст. ст. — «Мчч. Галактиона и Иулиании .»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Ιουνίου — «Αγία Ιουλιανή και Σατορνίνος ο γιος της»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The entry names both members, so it is one folder each. She is none of the corpus's three other Julianas — of Lazarevo, of Nicomedia and of Ptolemais — none of whom is kept on this day or has a son of this name. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
